channel.title: Live From The Path
channel.description:
Live From The Path is a Christian discussion podcast about faith, theology, church culture, and the challenges of following Jesus in everyday life.
Each week the hosts tackle questions about the Bible, apologetics, church leadership, relationships, and cultural issues — mixing thoughtful discussion with humor, games, and the popular Dear Live From The Path advice segment.
Honest conversations, questionable jokes, and practical wisdom for Christians trying to live faithfully in a complicated world.
channel.itunes:subtitle: Honest Faith. Fierce Grace. Donkeys.
